ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels covering approximately 90% of the visible surface, punctuated by high-intensity white linear and point-source disruptions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark base; high-intensity white clusters are localized at the distal lateral tips (left and right margins); extensive white linear mapping across the mid-sections of both lobes; fine white point distribution throughout the central dark regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a calculated convergence angle of approximately 45 degrees at the vertical midline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency irregular serration along the trailing edge; peaks are more pronounced and jagged on the medial portion of the right lobe near the notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex outward curve transitioning from the notch toward the distal tips on both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed circular and semi-circular white/gray pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) concentrated on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous multi-directional, high-contrast white linear marks (rake marks) crossing the dark pigment, with higher density visible on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive rake marks across the entire visible ventral surface and heavy barnacle encrustation on the lateral lobe margins.
other_distinctive_markers: Fine white stippling/speckling distribution across the dark field of the inner fluke lobes.
